hypotheses.justification: ContinuousMultilinearMap.apply 𝕜 M H u is a continuous linear evaluation map without any finiteness assumption (Topology/Algebra/Module/Multilinear/Topology.lean). DifferentiableOn is defined for topological vector spaces, so its statement still elaborates. For each x ∈ s, extract a derivative d from hc x hx and use (apply 𝕜 M H u).comp d as the derivative. Its remainder is evaluation of the original remainder; ContinuousLinearMap.isBigOTVS_comp and IsBigOTVS.trans_isLittleOTVS prove the required little-o estimate. This works for infinite or empty ι and trivial spaces; empty s is vacuous.
